description: Saves the changes of a local session in the session itself with LocalSession.Save(); it never checks in to the Project Server. Only a multiuser or an exclusive session can be saved: a server-project session is refused with 409 save_not_supported and nothing is changed. Returns {saved:true, session:{index, name, path, ...}}. `session` is the name or the full path of an open local session (as listed by tia_local_sessions; the project path first, then the project name ignoring case) and may be left out when exactly one session is open: none open is 409 no_local_session, several open without `session` (or a selector that matches several) is 409 ambiguous_session (details.sessions lists index, name and path), an unknown one is 404 not_found. dryRun (Gd11) is answered by the serve and reports the session and its isModified WITHOUT saving. Nothing is ever checked in to the Project Server: check-in (CloseAndCommit) is not offered by any tool. Maps to POST /multiuser/localsessions/save {session?}. Class M-off. Long operation: may answer status:"running" + jobId — then call tia_job_status.

dryRun.description: Gd11: plan-without-applying — validates the guards and describes the action WITHOUT mutating the project

session.description: name or full path of the open local session (from tia_local_sessions); optional when exactly one session is open

name: tia_local_session_save
title: TIA — save a local session
